explanation: Merges main (PR #88) into the cold-link change. From main: authorValidationFreshness.test.ts fails in CI when validation-records.generated.json disagrees with its ledgers or the inputSha256 the builder records; its three checks are marked it.fails until the 2026-10-25 records are regenerated, and the regenerating commit must change them back to it. The builder source-gate fixture supplies additional-comparison-specs.json and checks the five recorded input hashes. From this branch: bootLinkLoads.test.tsx removes the setup's seeded macaque globals and counts loadTrackData calls for cold links (each loads only its own track; a link refused after its check and the hub load none), and explorerStore.test.tsx pins a metadata failure keeping its banner while a track load starts and succeeds. Each new case fails with its fix removed.
